options.text: Wasm runs over HTTP on every call

questions.prompt: What subtle bug happens if JS caches `const view = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer)` at startup and Wasm later calls `memory.grow`?

options.text: `view` points to a detached `ArrayBuffer` (length 0), causing silent empty reads or errors until re-wrapped

options.text: It permits WebAssembly compilation without re-enabling dangerous JavaScript `eval()` / `new Function()`

options.text: Standardizing high-level typed interfaces (strings, records, lists, variants) across languages without manual pointer/memory ABI glue

questions.prompt: When compiling C/C++ to Wasm, why can `malloc`/`free` inside Wasm still leak memory even though linear memory is sandboxed?

options.text: Linear memory is managed by the guest allocator (`dlmalloc`/Rust allocator), so unfreed allocations keep growing pages until the tab runs out of memory
Wasm has a garbage collector that leaks
JS `GC` frees Wasm linear memory automatically

questions.prompt: What is Wasm SIMD (`v128`) used for?

questions.prompt: What is the role of `WasmGC` (WebAssembly Garbage Collection)?

options.text: Adding native managed struct/array heap types so GC languages (Kotlin, Dart, Java) compile to smaller, faster Wasm without bundling a full GC

questions.prompt: Why does shipping a custom C/Go garbage collector inside linear memory (without WasmGC) risk reference cycles across the JS/Wasm boundary?

options.text: Neither collector can see references held on the other side without weak refs / explicit `free()` / `FinalizationRegistry`

questions.prompt: What does `memory.atomic.wait32` / `memory.atomic.notify` enable?

questions.prompt: Why is `wasm32` (32-bit addresses) still the dominant Wasm target over `memory64` for most web apps?

options.text: 32-bit pointers use half the memory/cache footprint and fit within browser 2-4 GiB sandbox limits

questions.prompt: What happens if a Wasm module compiled with `memory.grow` tries to allocate beyond its `(memory 1 16)` maximum?

options.text: `memory.grow` returns `-1` and the guest allocator typically returns `NULL` or traps/panics

questions.prompt: What is a 'zero-copy' read pattern from JS into Wasm linear memory?

options.text: Creating a `Float32Array` / `Uint8Array` view directly over `memory.buffer` at the Wasm buffer pointer instead of copying arrays

questions.prompt: Why must `TextDecoder('utf-8')` NOT be called on a `SharedArrayBuffer`-backed `Uint8Array` directly?

options.text: The Web Encoding spec throws a `TypeError` if decoding a shared buffer view directly; copy the slice to a non-shared `Uint8Array` first

questions.prompt: What does `wasm-bindgen`'s `panic=abort` vs `panic=unwind` trade off in Rust Wasm builds?

options.text: `panic=abort` produces smaller binaries and avoids unwinding machinery, whereas `unwind` adds size
